correctness.rationale: A direct induction identifies every degree-two vertex color with its unordered pair of endpoint distances clipped at the current round. Within-thread stabilization occurs at half the thread length; unequal thread lengths remain cross-equivalent only until the shorter length, while equal lengths remain cross-equivalent forever. The cut-vertex distinction proves the resonant stable cell is non-orbital. A standalone checker verifies 2828 parameter pairs.
